### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-dev`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-dev/vitest.config.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via DevPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-dev/vitest.config.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6e3e5462c6d1ad3e6b0e3e88bea17b69dfefef9d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `be1eb700e1845395fdc2cc1c35c7ba097e5f200b` — the merge of head `a24f6ea84c3b8dbf1a8b6bf81bc29c763b0dc444` into base `6e3e5462c6d1ad3e6b0e3e88bea17b69dfefef9d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin be1eb700e1845395fdc2cc1c35c7ba097e5f200b && git checkout be1eb700e1845395fdc2cc1c35c7ba097e5f200b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6e3e5462c6d1ad3e6b0e3e88bea17b69dfefef9d a24f6ea84c3b8dbf1a8b6bf81bc29c763b0dc444 && git checkout -B drift-repro 6e3e5462c6d1ad3e6b0e3e88bea17b69dfefef9d && git merge --no-ff a24f6ea84c3b8dbf1a8b6bf81bc29c763b0dc444

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6e3e5462c6d1ad3e6b0e3e88bea17b69dfefef9d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6e3e5462c6d1ad3e6b0e3e88bea17b69dfefef9d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a24f6ea84c3b8dbf1a8b6bf81bc29c763b0dc444`
Local-runs: none

PR #20452 (draft, base `main`) for card #20376. Rendered read-only by an isolated contract-review subagent from the card's body and its six comments, the PR's body, file list and net diff against `main`, and the head's check-runs; the recogniser template, the plugin-dev `package.json`, the untouched neighbourhood of `dev-plugin.ts` and the suite files were read from the checkout, nothing was built, run or re-run. Adopted and posted by the session named in Reviewed-by.

**Check-runs on the head, read at 13:45 UTC, newest run per name:** 32 runs, 26 success, 3 skipped (`Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`), 0 failure, 3 still in progress: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core (1/6)`, `Type Check · workspace`. Success includes `Test Core (6/6)`, the shard the card's red was observed on, `Test Core (2/6)` to `(5/6)`, `Build Core`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Temporal Conformance`, all four Dogfood runs, both claim/branch guards, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, and the three completed type-check lanes. The three running checks have no verdict at this read and none is inferred here. `Lint & Repo Gates` is the job that runs `check:test-source-alias` and `check:comment-mask-adoption`, the two gates the dev reports red-then-fixed on the way, so their CI answer is still pending. The PASS below is the contract judgment of sections ① to ③; landing still waits on those three conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The load form of the setup / account app-package loop (`dev-plugin.ts`, one hunk).** The shared variable specifier `import(/* @vite-ignore */ spec[0])` becomes a per-entry literal loader, an arrow returning `import('@objectstack/setup')` on the first entry and one returning `import('@objectstack/account')` on the second, called as `spec[2]()`. Iteration order, the `await` per entry, the `enabled('auth')` gate the loop sits under, the `try` / `catch`, and the `reportOptionalLoadFailure` spec in the catch (`packages`, the `✘ … not installed — skipping its app` line at `warn`, `outcome`) are outside the hunk and unchanged. Accept-set of `DevPlugin.init()`: unchanged, same options, same tolerance of an absent package, same present-but-failed arm. **Right.**

2. **Published surface.** Both packages are `dependencies` (`workspace:^`) of `@objectstack/plugin-dev` (`package.json`, not in the diff), and the shared tsup config (`format: ['esm', 'cjs']`, `target: 'es2020'`, no `external` override, so dependencies are externalised) keeps a native dynamic import of an external in both formats and inlines nothing. The one implication: a consumer's bundler or static analyser now sees two already-hard dependency edges it could not see through the variable form. No export, option, log line or env knob is added, removed or renamed; `@objectstack/organizations` keeps its variable `webpackIgnore` form, as ADR-0132 requires. **Right**, and patch-shaped. The changeset's sentence that both builds keep a native `import("…")` is the dev's reading of the built dist; it is consistent with the build config and was not re-measured here.

3. **Dropping `/* @vite-ignore */`.** The hint only suppresses Vite's warning on a variable specifier. A literal is resolved when the file is transformed, which is exactly the mechanism the fix rests on (the specifier stops going to the main vitest process at call time). **Right.**

4. **`vitest.config.ts`: two anchored alias entries.** Exact-match regexes to `packages/apps/setup/src/index.ts` and `packages/apps/account/src/index.ts`; both files exist and their package names match; there was no earlier entry for either package, and the file's prefix-ordering caveat (`@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/types`) does not apply to an anchored find. Effect on the suites: every suite in which the loop runs mocks both packages, seven of the eight DevPlugin-booting suites; the eighth, `dev-plugin-malformed-stack-posture.test.ts`, boots with `auth: false`, so the loop and therefore the alias are never reached there. No suite's subject changes, and the `vi.mock` id and the literal import now resolve through the same entry. Test-only surface, nothing published. **Right.** Its gate, `check:test-source-alias`, is answered by `Lint & Repo Gates`, in progress at this read.

5. **The family pin, `dev-plugin-literal-imports.pin.test.ts`.** Walks `dev-plugin.ts` with the TypeScript parser, so a comment, a string or the `webpackIgnore` trivia cannot be misread as an import; ① the only non-literal specifier is `organizationsPkg`; ② that name is declared once, with the literal `'@objectstack/organizations'`; ③ a lit control that the walk sees setup, account and objectql as literals, so ① cannot pass vacuously. It pins the mechanism (the form of the specifier) rather than a timing, which is the "pin that it stays out" triage asked for, moved to where the measurement pointed; the PR's H2 shows ① and ③ red on the base blob under ablation with proven restores. `__dirname` over `import.meta` is right for a test program compiled as CommonJS; `typescript` is already a devDependency of the package. A template literal without substitutions would count as variable, which is stricter than needed and harmless. **Right.**

6. **The absent-arm case in `dev-plugin-optional-load-failure.test.ts`.** The suite's own factories throw a coded `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` error for both packages; vitest's mocker wraps it, `isModuleNotFound` reads the first coded link of the chain, and `loadFailureDetail` renders `code: … — message` across the chain, so the one `warn` line per package carries both the code and `Cannot find package '…'`, and nothing reaches `error`. Green on the base blob as well (H3), so it pins behaviour the fix preserves; red on a silent catch and on an `info` demotion. **Right.**

7. **No timeout, retry or arrangement change.** No existing test's `it`, timeout or retry is touched, and `dev-plugin-tenancy-mount-refusal.test.ts`, the file the card names, is not in the file list. Triage's ⛔ holds. **Right.**

8. **Direction.** The card's cold-start suspicion was falsified by round 1's measurement (a first-`init()` premium of about 10 ms; the load-dependent term is two main-process round trips per `init()`, on every case). The seat's route-A answer (`5865888222`) is the binding direction inside triage's grade, and the diff is route A exactly: the loop only, a cheap family pin, a patch changeset, plus the two additions the claim `5869085056` was amended in place to carry. **Right.**

Wrong: none found. The five files in the file list are the five the amended claim names, and nothing else.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/20376-plugin-dev-literal-app-imports.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-dev` `patch`. The diff publishes one thing, the load form of two declared dependencies inside a released package's dist; no export, option, spec key, log line or env knob is added, removed or renamed, so `patch` is both the floor and the ceiling. `Check Changeset` is success on the head. **Right.**
- The declaration line: the PR body, the amended claim and the changeset all carry the closed form `no` for Clause-②, with no arm. The diff widens no accept set and narrows none (nothing an author or operator writes or sees changes), so `no` is right and no ADR-0087 marker is owed. **Right.**
- Changeset body against the code: the quoted absent line matches the `absent` template in the loop's catch; "every other declared dependency it loads" is accurate, since the organizations load is the deliberate exception and is not declared; the migration section is correctly absent for a non-breaking change. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

**Open questions.**
- Round 1 (`5865793469`): one, the route A / B / C decision. Answered by the seat at `5865888222` (route A, an implementation route inside triage's direction, no product-visible change); the diff executes it. **Answered.**
- Final report (`5871003036`): `open_questions: []`. **Nothing to answer.**

**Dev flags, final report (`5871003036`).**
1. `vitest.config.ts` outside the claim's listed surface: the claim `5869085056` was amended in place after the report to carry it (its current text names the two aliases); mechanical consequence of route A. **Answered**; the CI answer for its gate is pending in `Lint & Repo Gates`.
2. One case added to `dev-plugin-optional-load-failure.test.ts`: amended into the same claim. **Answered.**
3. Throwaway probe files lived inside the package, were copied out and deleted: the file list shows the five files only. **Answered, no residue.**
4. First silent-catch ablation refused by the tool and retried with a different anchor: procedural. **Answered.**
5. First `label-write` ran without a token and wrote nothing; the re-run made the one assignee write: procedural. **Answered.**
6. `origin/main` moved after the merge on no touched file and the branch was not re-merged: the PR reads `mergeable: true` against the moved base. **Answered.**
7. A full workspace build to meet two PREREQUISITE NOT MET gates: wider than the closure, no residue in the diff. **Answered.**
8. Verification ran UNLOCKED (no `flock` on macOS): a declared narrowing, pasted verbatim in the PR body with the command list; the head's check-runs are the gate verdicts and are recorded above. **Answered.**
9. Attribution: AGENTS.md's model-free trailer pair and session-URL footer over the harness reminder: right by the repo's own rule (the PR footer carries the session URL); the commit trailers themselves were not among this review's inputs. **Answered.**
10. PR-body readback blank line; worktree removed after the PR opened: cosmetic and procedural. **Answered.**

**Dev flags, round 1 (`5865793469`).** Fence stop with no PR and one report comment (the measurement pointed into `DevPlugin` itself), a worktree on a newer `main` with an empty plugin-dev diff, one MCP job-log read after the REST redirect was refused at the proxy, CPU-load loops on the shared box with every PID cleaned, temporary source mutation for measurement with proven restores and no delivered change, no commit so the trailer was moot. **All answered by the seat's route-A answer; none carries into the diff.**

**Takeover flags (PR body).** The continuation read the dead dev's two pushed commits as unverified work, kept the code lines, corrected the comment, changeset and pin header where they overstated ("like every other load", the `await import` wording, un-re-measured timings), rewrote the pin as an AST walk after `check:comment-mask-adoption` refused the regex stripper, and added the alias entries and the absent-arm case. The diff read here is the corrected text. **Answered.**

**Out-of-scope findings, noted and not filed.**
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` loads setup / account through the same variable-specifier loop (`webpackIgnore`): a spawned CLI process has no vitest main process, so it costs nothing there, and there is no failing reproduction. Noted-not-filed is right; it is the same construct, so this card is the first read if an in-process suite ever shows the shape. **Not escalated.**
- The `MODULE_NOT_FOUND_CODES` docblock says the CJS build resolves through `require()` while the dist keeps `import()`: both codes stay in the set, so it is drift with no behavioural consequence. **Not escalated.**
- Census carries (`dev-plugin-malformed-stack-posture.test.ts` case 4's real cold load inside an explicit `60_000` window; the i18n reader's first-use cost): the seat's answer already directed that they stay in the PR's Acceptance notes unless re-measurement said otherwise, and neither is failing. **Not escalated.**
- Round 1's per-suite census entries were each "covered by the route decision", and route A is what landed. **Closed by the diff.**

Escalations: none. Pending, not escalated: the three in-progress check-runs named above.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20376-plugin-dev-cold-start`
Reviewed-by: `local_1d2a197c-c20e-4e90-9be8-413d4d432289`

**VERDICT: PASS**

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [36433026729](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/36433026729) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test Core (1/6)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/36433026729/job/108963923947)** — 失败步骤: Run this shard's tests

  ```
  @objectstack/spec:test:  FAIL   local  src/data/filter-number-comparand-declared-type.test.ts > [#20336] the judged positions > partition FieldOperatorsSchema's keys with the text operators and the tw
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/spec:test: AssertionError: expected [ '$between', '$contains', …(16) ] to deeply equal [ '$between', '$contains', …(17) ]
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `src/data/filter-number-comparand-declared-type.test.ts` — 24h 内已弹出 **2 个互相独立的 PR**（#20442、#20452）。汇总 issue：#20455（新建）
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 1 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
